definitions.explanation: A very polite or honorific way to refer to a person. Used to show respect, especially when referring to someone of high status or someone else's family member.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{御方|おかた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{素敵|すてき}な{御方|おかた}です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御方|おかた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧になって⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: The person over there is waiting for you. (very polite)

notes:
An honorific noun for referring to a person, composed of {御|お} (honorific prefix) and ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (person, direction). More respectful than ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ or ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ alone. Often used in formal settings, period dramas, and polite conversation.

POLITENESS LEVELS FOR "PERSON":
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: person (neutral)
- ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: person (polite)
- {御方|おかた}: person (very polite/honorific)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{御方|おかた}: that person (respectful)
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な{御方|おかた}: a fine/distinguished person
- {優|やさ}しい{御方|おかた}: a kind person (spoken with reverence)

USAGE:
More commonly heard in formal or literary contexts. In everyday modern conversation, ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ is sufficient for polite speech. {御方|おかた} appears in historical dramas, formal ceremonies, and when speaking with great deference about someone.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: person (polite) — the standard polite form
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: person — neutral
- お⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: alternate writing of the same word
- {御仁|ごじん}: person (literary/archaic honorific)
